facts.P1_fx_receipts: No surrender rule, but banks are impaired; use fresh-dollar accounts.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Fresh-dollar accounts exist; rules not confirmed yet.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Transfer operators like OMT and Whish weren't researched yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: A single tax identification number from the tax administration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Services performed in Lebanon are taxable, at 4–25% for business income.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 11% VAT above LBP 5 billion; exports are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: Never put foreign earnings into old frozen dollar accounts.
